title: Quantifying EGFR endosomal recycling via immunofluorescence in breast cancer cells
protocol: Precoat Lab-tek chamber slides with fibronectin (0.1 mg/mL) by adding 200 μL per well and then incubate for minimum 15 min at 37°C.
Aspirate fibronectin and seed cells at 20,000 cells per well into RPMI supplemented with 10% FBS and 0.023 IU/mL insulin.
Replace medium with low serum medium (RPMI/0.1% FBS) to starve cells for 20 h.
Wash cells twice with RPMI prior to addition of starvation medium if necessary.
Visually inspect the health and morphology of the cells before and after the low serum starvation.
Maximize cell surface presentation of EGFR by optimizing starvation times from 2 h to 24 h depending on cell lines or receptors.
Place cells on ice.
Aspirate the medium gently using an Eppendorf P1000 or similar pipette.
Replace aspirated medium with 200 μL of cell surface labeling solution per well.
Incubate chamber slides with cell surface labeling solution at 4°C for 60 min with gentle rocking on a rocking platform mixer.
Place all chamber slides on ice after incubation.
Fix the baseline (pre-endocytosis) sample with fixation solution for 5 min on ice.
Transfer fixed samples to room temperature (21°C–25°C) for an additional 10 min.
Wash samples twice with PBS (1×).
Cover and store samples at 4°C until further processing.
Aspirate cell surface labeling solution from chamber slides.
Replace with pre-warmed trafficking solution while on ice.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 15 min to allow EGF-dependent internalization of antibody-labeled EGFR.
Place all chamber slides on ice after the incubation.
Aspirate trafficking solution to remove unbound EGF and antibody.
Add cold acid strip solution and incubate with gentle rocking for 5 min.
Aspirate acid strip solution completely.
Wash gently ×4 with cold trafficking solution.
Fix the post-endocytosis pulse sample and 0 min recycling sample with fixation solution for 5 min on ice followed by 10 min at room temperature (21°C–25°C).
Wash wells ×2 with PBS after fixation.
Store at 4°C covered with PBS until processing.
Aspirate cold trafficking solution while still on ice.
Replace with pre-warmed trafficking solution to allow recycling.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 30 min to allow antibody-labeled EGFR back to the cell surface.
Perform a time course (5–60 min) to determine the best recycling time point.
Fix cells with fixation solution for 5 minutes on ice followed by 10 minutes at room temperature (21°C–25°C).
Wash cells twice with PBS (1×).
Store fixed cells at 4°C covered with PBS (1×) until processing.
Aspirate PBS and wash cells three times in wash buffer (non-perm) or three times in wash buffer (perm) [for the post-endocytosis pulse only].
Add 200 μL of block solution (non-perm) or block solution (perm) [for the post-endocytosis pulse only] per well and incubate at room temperature (21°C–25°C) for 60 minutes.

Aspirate the block solution and add 200 μL of secondary antibody solution (anti-mouse-Alexa488+ 2 μg/mL) diluted in appropriate block solution, then incubate in the dark at room temperature (21°C–25°C) for 60 minutes with gentle rocking.
Wash cells three times in wash buffer (non-perm) or three times in wash buffer (perm) [for the post-endocytosis pulse only].
Mount using ProLong Gold Antifade Mountant with DAPI.
